jobs_results.title: Sr Data Analyst Indore (India)
jobs_results.description:
Lumenore is looking for Sr. Data Analyst to join our energetic team and embark on a rewarding career journey. As a Senior Data Analyst, your role is to gather, analyze, and interpret complex data to provide valuable insights and support data-driven decision-making within an organization. You work with large datasets, employ statistical techniques, and use various tools and technologies to extract meaningful information.   

Here are some key responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the role of a Senior Data Analyst:Data Collection and Exploration: Collecting and organizing data from various sources, such as databases, data warehouses, APIs, or external sources.   

You explore and understand the data, identify data quality issues, and ensure data integrity.Data Analysis and Modeling: Applying statistical analysis, data mining techniques, and advanced analytical methods to extract insights from data. You develop models and algorithms to uncover patterns, correlations, and trends, and generate actionable recommendations based on your findings.Data Visualization and Reporting: Creating visualizations, dashboards, and reports to present data analysis results in a transparent and compelling manner.   

You use tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Python libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn to visually communicate complex data to stakeholders.Business Intelligence and Decision Support: Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and translate them into data analysis projects.   

You provide analytical support to decision-making processes, helping stakeholders make informed and data-driven decisions.Data Quality and Governance: Ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with data governance policies. You validate and cleanse data, establish data quality standards, and implement data governance frameworks to maintain data integrity.   

Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. .

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (No Experience Required)
jobs_results.description:
Build your data analytics career at Fusion5 as a Data Analyst (No Experience Required) in Ujjain. This is a full-time position with genuine ownership from the first month — your own datasets, your own dashboards, and stakeholders who rely on them.

About the role
In this Data Analyst (No Experience Required) position you will be trusted with real business questions. Day to day that means an analyst seat open to candidates with no prior work experience — training on SQL, Excel and Power BI is part of the role with SQL, Excel and Power BI, and holding a high bar on data quality, documentation and clarity of communication.

Key responsibilities
• Prepare and clean datasets for the analytics team under a senior analyst
• Build simple dashboards and recurring reports, reviewed before release
• Run first-pass analyses and summarise what the data shows
• Cross-check published numbers against source systems
• Document your queries and steps so the work is repeatable
• Validate and reconcile numbers before they are published, and document known data caveats
• Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on analysis rather than refreshes
• Present findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, plain language

Required skills and tools
• SQL
• Advanced Excel
• Power BI
• Tableau
• Python (Pandas)
• Data Cleaning
• Data Visualization
• Descriptive Statistics
• Dashboarding
• Business Acumen
• Stakeholder Communication
• Documentation

Eligibility criteria
• Education: any graduate — B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, BCA/MCA, B.Com, BBA or MBA. Candidates from any recognised university are welcome.
• Graduation year: 2023–2026 batches. Freshers and final-year students awaiting results may apply.
• Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA in the highest qualification (indicative — strong practical skills can offset this).
• Experience: 0–0 years in analytics, reporting, MIS or a closely related function.
• Technical skills: SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning.
• Soft skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, stakeholder communication, ownership and the confidence to flag a number that looks wrong.

Salary and compensation
• Annual CTC: ₹2,40,000 – ₹3,90,000 per year (2.4 LPA – 3.9 LPA), an indicative market range for this role in Ujjain.
• Monthly equivalent: approximately ₹26,000 per month at the mid-point of the range.
• Currency: INR (₹).
• Performance bonus / variable pay as per Fusion5's policy, reviewed annually.
• The exact offer is confirmed by Fusion5 based on your interview performance and current compensation.

Perks and benefits
• Flexible / hybrid working options
• Modern analytics tooling and licensed BI seats
• Clear appraisal cycle and internal mobility
• Employee wellness programmes
• Team offsites and networking opportunities
• Competitive salary as per market benchmarks
• Annual performance bonus / variable pay
• Health insurance for you and your dependants

Location, work mode and employment type
• Location: Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh
• Work mode: Work From Office
• Employment type: Full-time, permanent
• Working hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Monday to Friday
• Number of openings: 4
• Joining: immediate to 60 days, as per your notice period

Selection process
• Round 1 — Resume screening and profile shortlisting by the talent acquisition team
• Round 2 — Technical interview 1 — SQL joins, aggregations, window functions and data modelling
• Round 3 — Case study / take-home assignment on a real dataset, with a walkthrough of your approach
• Round 4 — HR discussion — compensation, notice period, joining date and offer roll-out

Who should apply
Candidates from any graduate — B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, BCA/MCA, B.Com, BBA or MBA with up to 0 years of relevant experience who are based in Ujjain or willing to relocate. You should be comfortable with SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI and able to explain your analysis to someone who has never seen the data. Portfolio projects, Kaggle work, a GitHub repo or published dashboards strengthen an application, especially for early-career candidates.

Why join Fusion5
At Fusion5 the analytics function is treated as core, not a back-office service. You will have direct access to stakeholders, room to challenge assumptions and support to keep learning. There is a clear progression path from Analyst to Senior Analyst, and onward into analytics leadership or a specialist data-science / data-engineering track. You will leave every year of this role with your first analytics job, with the tools taught on the job.

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not signed in you will be asked to log in or create a free MyInternships.in candidate account first, after which you will be taken directly to Fusion5's official careers page to submit your application. Applications close on 16 October 2026 and are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply early.

Additional information
• Documents required at the interview stage: updated resume, degree certificates or provisional certificate, and government photo ID.
• Experienced candidates should also carry recent payslips and a relieving or experience letter.
• There is no service bond for this position, and no equipment deposit is taken.
• A laptop and licensed analytics tooling are provided by Fusion5 for office and hybrid roles.
• Fusion5 and MyInternships.in never charge a fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. If anyone asks you for money in the name of this job, do not pay — report it. Responsibilities: Prepare and clean datasets for the analytics team under a senior analyst; Build simple dashboards and recurring reports, reviewed before release; Run first-pass analyses and summarise what the data shows; Cross-check published numbers against source systems; Document your queries and steps so the work is repeatable; Validate and reconcile numbers before publishing, and document data caveats; Automate recurring reporting to free up time for real analysis; Present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Requirements: any graduate — B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, BCA/MCA, B.Com, BBA or MBA from a recognised university; 0–0 years of experience in analytics, reporting or MIS — freshers and 2026 graduates are welcome; Working knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI; Comfort with SQL, Excel and Power BI and with cleaning messy, real-world data; Ability to define a metric precisely and explain a result to a non-technical stakeholder; Attention to detail, ownership and the discipline to document your work; Based in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh or willing to relocate.

jobs_results.job_title: Data Analyst – AV Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics
jobs_results.description:
Data Analyst - Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Operations & Infrastructure


Role: Data Analyst – AV Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics


Experience: 4–6 Years


Location: Remote / Flexible
Industry: Global Tech & Mobility Leader


About the Team & Opportunity


Our team owns the end-to-end data foundation driving autonomous vehicle (AV) support operations for one of the world's leading mobility platforms. Every operational metric, real-time rider contact, automated data-quality check, and pre-launch feature instrumentation flows through the systems we architect.


We sit directly at the intersection of AV Program Teams, Operational Analytics, and Core Data Engineering to turn complex operational data into actionable, trustworthy insights.


What You'll Do
Redefine the Core Data Layer: Transform organically grown data environments into a deliberate, clean \"gold layer.\" Consolidate overlapping tables, optimize upstream join logic, and establish unified canonical datasets.Deliver Business Analytics & Insights: Partner with AV program leadership to scope ambiguous business challenges, define metrics, build dashboards, and answer high-impact operational questions.Guide Instrumentation for New AV Products: Review Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) across launch lifecycles to ensure proper event logging and telemetry are live before new features ship.Maintain & Govern Data Infrastructure: Monitor daily pipelines for freshness, accuracy, and volume. Build governance frameworks around SLAs, change-management workflows, and automated incident alerting.Scale Real-Time Analytics: Expand streaming feeds (Kafka/Flink/Pinot) to lower latency and power real-time operational notifications as incidents develop.What You'll Need
4–6 years in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or Data Engineering with a focus on dataset and pipeline ownership (not just query consumption).Advanced SQL & Distributed Computing: Hands-on experience building production transformations in Spark SQL and Hive, authoring canonical patterns that other engineers build on.Customer Support Data Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with support operations metrics (contacts, tickets, handle time, CSAT) and the nuances of handling messy, multi-grained data.Strong Stakeholder Communication: Proven ability to scope vague business requests, push back when framing is off, and present clear takeaways to non-technical partners.AI Tool Integration: Practical experience using AI/agentic coding platforms to accelerate pipeline, analysis, and dashboard development with high validation rigor.Preferred Qualifications
AV / Autonomous Systems Interest: Understanding of or genuine curiosity about how autonomous trip operations and support models work.Semantic & Metric Layers: Experience with dbt, LookML, or proprietary metric management systems.Streaming & Real-Time Analytics: Familiarity with Kafka, Flink, Pinot, or real-time event processing.Orchestration & Observability: Hands-on experience with Airflow and data observability tools.Dashboarding & Apps: Proficiency with Tableau, Streamlit, Retool, or custom internal tool suites.Anam Chaudhry
[REDACTED PHONE]
